horizon.scenario_semantics: One mutually exclusive full-day world is realized. Any named outage is announced before care begins; no mid-session transfer is promised.

disclosures: Every person, offer, payment ceiling, wage and price is synthetic.
Declared capacity/staffing/qualification inputs are contractual scenario data, not legal childcare ratios or licensed-provider validation.
The output is a verified finite commitment/schedule package, not delivered childcare.
Backup is prepaid for at most one realized daily world, with the worst declared activation fully reserved.
Unused activation reserve is refundable; it is not coordinator revenue.
Workers' permitted shifts and providers' offer-acceptance flags are assumptions of this synthetic instance, not observed consent.

payer_allocation.rule: Deterministic exact eligible maximum flow, not a fairness optimum.

every worker permitted shift and compensation
every child's full commute-inclusive interval and acceptable location
declared provider capacity, staffing, qualifications and windows
every enumerated contingency
every eligible payer ceiling
transformation_witness.financial_instrument: Prepaid primary and standby offers, fully reserved finite backup, paid worker changes.
